U.note: Charming helmeted pelican with a wing on the bar, clean IK legs, parallax scenery and tidy controls, though the pedal mechanics are a bit small.

V.note: Oversized pelican body on a thin frame with a murky grey band behind the road, but night mode, reverse, bell with sound and a readout make it feature-rich and working.

W.note: Clean, readable pelican on bike with a bell button, accessible controls and good phone layout, but the scenery is sparse and the rider is a little stiff.

X.note: Well-composed scene with helmet, blinking eye, honk, parallax hills and keyboard shortcuts; the wing and legs read clearly, though the speed slider's range is odd.

Y.note: Good trees and pouch detail, but hill tiles show a visible seam, the wheels are small against the large bird, and a focus box appears on the bell click.

Z.note: Most polished: big racing bike, arm reaching the grip, S-curved neck with nod, bell with speech bubble, road-scroll toggle, reduced-motion handling and 44px touch targets.
